items.html:
Wellness Parents is a Muslim parent and caregiver initiative that brings parents and caregivers together to learn, connect, and strengthen the support system surrounding our youth and families.

As parents, we play an important role in supporting the emotional wellness, safety, and overall well-being of our children and young adults. Wellness Parents creates opportunities for parents to connect with one another, learn from trusted professionals and community organizations, share concerns and experiences, and take part in shaping solutions for Muslim families.

Through conversations, workshops, resources, community activities, and parent-led involvement, Wellness Parents works to build stronger connections between families, youth, mosques, professionals, and community organizations.

mainText:
Wellness Parents
Parents for Wellness. Communities for Change.

Wellness Parents is a Muslim parent and caregiver initiative that brings parents and caregivers together to learn, connect, and strengthen the support system surrounding our youth and families.

As parents, we play an important role in supporting the emotional wellness, safety, and overall well-being of our children and young adults. Wellness Parents creates opportunities for parents to connect with one another, learn from trusted professionals and community organizations, share concerns and experiences, and take part in shaping solutions for Muslim families.

Through conversations, workshops, resources, community activities, and parent-led involvement, Wellness Parents works to build stronger connections between families, youth, mosques, professionals, and community organizations.

Our Goal

Healthier communities where wellness is valued, support is accessible, and families do not have to navigate challenges alone.Wellness Parents aims to create a supportive community where Muslim parents and caregivers can find information, build connections, recognize when support may be needed, and become more involved in conversations affecting the well-being of their children and families.

Join Wellness Parents

Interested in helping strengthen wellness and support for Muslim youth and families? Join Wellness Parents and be part of a growing community of Muslim parents working together to support healthier youth, stronger families, and stronger communities.
Your involvement can help strengthen the support system surrounding Muslim youth and families.

Whether you want to participate in parent discussions, help organize community activities, share your experiences, connect families with resources, or simply stay informed, there is a place for you in Wellness Parents.
